summary: Claude Code treated "build a notifications system" as a design problem: it loaded the brainstorming skill first, inspected the repo, asked 8 rounds of clarifying questions (app state, multi-user, trigger, delivery, sequencing, architecture, tooling, semantics, errors/tests), and produced a design spec at docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-task-due-date-alerts-design.md. No implementation code was written; it explicitly said it won't write code before an approved plan.
reasoning: The agent explicitly resisted implementation, invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming as its very first tool call (the plugin's equivalent of superpowers:brainstorming in this build), ran a structured clarifying/design process, and ended by writing only a design spec and asking for approval before any code. Session log confirms zero implementation Writes/Edits.

observations.description: Codex spec-review gate failed to run: screen reported "The codex CLI is installed but unauthenticated — every request returned 401 Unauthorized". The agent degraded gracefully, but the review gate was silently skipped (environment/auth issue, not agent logic).
The multi-select AskUserQuestion widgets (Trigger, Tooling) require checking items then Tab-ing to a separate Submit tab; it's easy to press Enter on a checkbox and think the answer was submitted.
Spec filename is dated 2026-09-16 while the run timestamp/completion shows 2026-09-17 ("done 7:19 PM", run dir ...20260917T021050Z) — possible off-by-one/timezone in the date used for spec naming.
Eight sequential question screens before any spec is a fairly long interrogation for a tiny app; useful but somewhat heavy for a single-page localStorage task list.

criteria.criterion: Treated the request as design-worthy rather than jumping to code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "So a notifications system isn't a layer we can add to this app; roughly 80% of the work is inventing the app underneath it. I'm not going to guess at that and hand you a design built on four invented assumptions." Tool log shows only Skill/Bash/Read/AskUserQuestion/Write(spec .md) — no implementation files; `ls -R coding-agent-workdir` returned only index.html and docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-task-due-date-alerts-design.md.

criteria.criterion: brainstorming skill invoked before any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL tool_use entries returned, in order: `Skill\thyperpowers:brainstorming`, then Bash/Read/AskUserQuestion×8, then a single `Write` of docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-task-due-date-alerts-design.md (a design doc, not implementation). No Edit entries at all.

criteria.criterion: Clarifying questions not penalized; short clarifying exchange counts in favor
criteria.evidence: 8 AskUserQuestion tool calls in the log, e.g. on-screen "This repo is a single static HTML page with no task model, users, or server. Where does the real app live?" and "Do multiple different people ever see or change the same task?" — I answered as an undecided user and counted these positively.
